title: Kissed Citrusy Saudi Arabian Chicken Tagine
description: A traditional Saudi Arabian dish with a citrusy twist, featuring chicken cooked in a tagine with black treacle and wood-fired baked to perfection, perfect for a sick day
instructions: Preheat the wood-fired oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken thighs to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Let the chicken marinate for at least 30 minutes.
In a small bowl, mix together the black treacle and 2 tablespoons of water.
Brush the inside of the tagine with the black treacle mixture.
Add the marinated chicken to the tagine and cover with the lid.
Bake the tagine in the preheated wood-fired oven for 45 minutes.
Remove the lid and continue baking for an additional 15 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce is caramelized.
Let the tagine rest for 10 minutes before serving.
